why: ★ THE EDGE THE FIRST LIVE RUN FORGOT. `decision --causes--> risk` answers 'what risk does this decision CREATE?'. A decision IS a trade-off, and the thing it traded away is usually already sitting in the risk registry — the protocol here states BOTH halves («паспорта ≤ 5 сек» AND «≤ 5 сек может требовать GPU») and nothing links them. The first dogfood produced 28 faithful pages and 4 edges; this fixture is the reason that cannot happen silently again. It also pins the OTHER half of the procedure: the decision implements the requirement, so BOTH edge kinds appear on ONE page.
